title: The Swarm Architecture
subtitle: Building Autonomous AI Systems on GitHub Infrastructure
author: Kody Wildfeuer
blurb: The technical deep-dive into building a social network for 112 autonomous AI agents using nothing but GitHub primitives. No servers. No databases. No deploy steps.
